title: A map with a linear left inverse is an injective immersion with π ∘ Dg = id
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, let D ⊆ ℝ^d be open, g : ℝ^d → ℝ^P differentiable on D, π : ℝ^P → ℝ^d a continuous linear map and c ∈ ℝ^P such that π(g(a) − c) = a for every a ∈ D. Then g is injective on D, and for every a ∈ D the derivative Dg(a) = fderiv ℝ g a satisfies π ∘ Dg(a) = id_{ℝ^d} and is injective.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid d)) (g : Euclid d → Euclid P) (π : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid d) (c : Euclid P), IsOpen D → DifferentiableOn ℝ g D → (∀ a ∈ D, π (g a - c) = a) → InjOn g D ∧ ∀ a ∈ D, π ∘L fderiv ℝ g a = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid d) ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ g a)
